story: Patagonia Lake State Park is a state park of Arizona, United States, containing Patagonia Lake. The 250-acre lake is habitat for reproducing largemouth bass, black crappie, bluegill, green sunfish, flathead catfish, threadfin shad, redear sunfish, channel catfish, and American bullfrogs.
matters: The 873-acre preserve protects a magnificent example of the rare Fremont cottonwood-Goodding willow riparian forest, with some trees more than 100 feet tall and 130 years old.
name: Patagonia Lake State Park
